route: Humberto Delgado Airport (LIS) Terminal 1 → Príncipe Real
why_this_route: The scenario's own problem list states: 'Getting from arrival to the accommodation on site is stressful.' Príncipe Real is where the Airbnb captured earlier sits (F-71 capture), so this is the literal continuation of the same traveller's journey.

finding_F99_ATTRIBUTES_NOBODY_ELSE_SHOWS.claim: Citymapper presents transit options with frequency, calories and cross-mode alternatives alongside price and duration — three attributes absent from every other competitor in the roster.

the_three_new_attributes.frequency: 'Every 7 min' — how long you wait if you miss one. NO other roster competitor surfaces service frequency anywhere.
the_three_new_attributes.calories: 389 cal walking, 234 cycling. An effort measure in a literal physiological unit — the only non-time, non-money effort metric found in the round.
the_three_new_attributes.cross_mode_alternatives_with_times: Walk / Cycle / Cab shown together with durations, so 39 min by transit sits against 33 min by cab and 94 min on foot.

finding_F99_ATTRIBUTES_NOBODY_ELSE_SHOWS.why_frequency_matters_MOST_for_luma: For a first-time traveller the fear at arrival is not cost or even duration — it is being stranded. 'Every 7 min' answers a question none of the other sixteen competitors even acknowledges: what happens if I miss it. It is a reassurance datum that costs nothing to display and exists in every transit feed.
finding_F99_ATTRIBUTES_NOBODY_ELSE_SHOWS.for_luma: Luma's Core Features list includes 'Arrival transport to the accommodation' at stage 5 and 'Transport on site — routes, tickets, passes' at stage 6. This capture is the working reference for both, and it demonstrates that the useful attributes at that moment are NOT the ones the booking products optimise for.

finding_F100_EFFORT_MEASURED_IN_A_THIRD_.claim: Across the roster, effort is now observed measured in three different units, and which unit is used depends entirely on what the vertical can compute.

the_three_units.time: flights and rail — duration, change count (F-25 correction, F-43, F-92)
the_three_units.carbon: Google Flights — emissions relative to route average, sortable (F-35)
the_three_units.calories: Citymapper — physiological effort for active modes (this capture)

finding_F100_EFFORT_MEASURED_IN_A_THIRD_.accommodation_and_activities: ZERO effort units. 20 accommodation ranking axes contain none (F-25); activity duration exists only inside seller prose (F-83).
finding_F100_EFFORT_MEASURED_IN_A_THIRD_.the_synthesis: Every vertical that CAN quantify effort does, and competes on it. Every vertical that cannot, ignores it entirely. Luma's opportunity is not to invent an effort axis — three already exist in three units — it is to compute one where the data does not yet exist: accommodation and on-site activities.

surface_structure.note_on_time_basis: 'Arrive by' is offered as a first-class option. For a traveller with a check-in time or a booked activity, working backwards from an arrival time is the actual need. No booking competitor in the roster offers an arrive-by search.
surface_structure.meet_me_somewhere_note: A feature for finding a midpoint between two people. Relevant to the scenario's 'Families travelling with children — coordinating several people' user type, which F-59 established is addressed by almost nothing in the roster.
surface_structure.named_operators_lisbon: Metro, Comboios Urbanos De Lisboa, Carris, Transtejo & Soflusa — the actual local transit authorities, named.

web_vs_app.web_is_functional: Route planning worked end to end in the browser: origin, destination, alternatives, prices, frequencies and a map.
web_vs_app.app_promoted: 'Get the App' present, but the web surface is not a marketing shell — contrast Hopper (F-65), where the differentiating products were app-gated.

ticketing_status.observation: Fares are shown (1,90 €) but no purchase or ticketing affordance was found on the rendered surface — swept for ticket, pass, fare, pay, buy, price, card.
ticketing_status.recorded_as: NOT OBSERVED. Citymapper is known to sell transit tickets in some cities; whether Lisbon is one was not established.
ticketing_status.tier_3_relevance: The tier-3 argument requires SOMEONE in the roster to complete an on-site transport purchase. Trainline's fulfilment is still unverified after three attempts; Omio is blocked at consent; Rome2Rio does not sell. Citymapper's ticketing is unconfirmed. The tier-3 justification therefore still rests on assumption rather than observation — after four of four tier-3 competitors have been touched.

not_observed: whether tickets can be purchased for Lisbon
